title: Edition-specific licensing and first ruleset kernel
summary: Provisional recommendation: Knave first edition for a small CC BY 4.0 inventory/ability kernel; pin the actual licensed source and rule fixtures before implementation. Keep SRD5.2.1 as a later tactical adapter. The existing tempted-fates/1.0.0 remains unchanged. This is a source audit and engineering recommendation, not a blanket clearance of every asset or product.

claims.statement: The author explicitly grants CC BY4.0 for Knave1.0 and describes a small classless, equipment-led six-ability toolkit. This grant is edition-specific. Full artifact bytes have not been acquired or hashed in this pass.
Cairn text is CC BY-SA4.0, not plain CC BY. Commercial use and share-alike obligations must be assessed for adapted material; copying into a private upload lane does not remove license conditions.

Blades SRD uses CC BY3.0 Unported with required credit. The setting, NPCs, artwork and maps outside the SRD are excluded; logo/trademark permissions are separate. Its adjudicative position/effect and consequences are not a tiny automatic three-result ruleset.
D&D SRD5.2.1 is CC BY4.0; that does not license all Basic Rules, books, settings, artwork or brand use. Pin the specific SRD and required attribution.

OSE is not established as a CC BY kernel: the publisher distinguishes pre2026 OGL material from a new2026 third-party license and describes a CC SRD as prospective for early2027. Availability of a compatibility logo is not blanket text permission.

Year Zero uses a custom FTL, not CC BY. Retrieved excerpt specifies printed/PDF/VTT forms; full terms were inaccessible. Whether an autonomous AI runtime fits the grant remains unresolved. Do not treat Year Zero and Forged in the Dark as identical outcome systems.
Do not transfer Knave1e’s CC BY grant to Knave2e. This pass has not authenticated a sufficient second-edition text/art reuse license.

rules: First acquire/pin lawfully distributed Knave1e source; no purchase or bulk source redistribution occurred here.
Implement a deliberately small supported subset: ability resolution, carried-item capacity, custody and explicit consequences. Refuse unimplemented combat/magic rather than inventing outcomes.
Keep license provenance separate from runtime rights scope. Even open-license material must not merge tenant-private campaign context.
SRD5.2.1 follows as an adapter with version-specific actions, initiative, resources and tests. No silent change to the existing ruleset version.

If avoiding any artifact acquisition is essential, evaluate the accessible Blades SRD as a fallback, accepting its larger adjudication surface. Cairn is an option only with an explicit share-alike content strategy.

open_questions: Knave1e mechanics cannot be frozen from storefront summaries alone; obtain source bytes and exact rule fixtures first.
YearZero full-license access and AI-runtime applicability remain unresolved.
Recheck the actually published OSE2026 license; do not build on a promised2027 CC release.
